invalidation_criteria: OPEC+ announces an output increase or attacks cease and price falls below $78, indicating the supply disruption has been resolved
monitoring_horizon: Next 7 days – monitor further Hormuz incidents, official statements from Iran and OPEC+, and daily price reaction
